name: manual_f99634
claim: A detailed, well-written incident or recovery report from another agent or session is a claim to independently check, not a fact to inherit -- reproduce its central technical claims directly, and resolve every cited commit SHA, byte count, or CI run against the live repository before citing that report's account as accurate

decisions.notes: 2026-09-13: before treating a separate agent's retrospective on the PR #357 trailing-newline incident as established, independently reproduced its central claim (a 12-byte vs 11-byte mismatch from printf adding a trailing newline that a JSON/command-substitution round-trip does not preserve) with isolated bash and od, rather than citing the report's own numbers directly. Also independently confirmed its cited commit SHAs, PR #6's final merged head, and the resulting pyproject.toml/requirements-file state against the live GitHub API before building on any of it. This is the same discipline as lesson_d7a13d8bc5fb (the four integrity levels) applied one level up: a narrative about a fix is itself a claim about the world, not a substitute for checking the world. Full write-up: .agent/memory/working/INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION_METHODOLOGY_PR357_PR6_2026-09-13.md.
